statement: Native Dolphin 2503 MP-only control with hid-generic and both shims on reaches mode 05 without a child, receives both exact imported MP calibration chunks and shows a changing gyro indicator in the mapping view during a 150-second bound. Native raw observation sees 14002 report 0x37 frames, but decoded success is established by the separate UI samples, not raw counts. Both native and combined post-mode-05 A400F0=55 counts are zero. This is a bounded MP-only positive control, not MP+Nunchuk, rate, physical or game acceptance.
